title: Portfolio contents index: six staggered chapter panels with art-derived tag colors
contains_third_party_content: Artwork of unknown authorship in six styles; 'Nike Ad Film' is a brand title.

observed.layout: Near-black page with a brush-script italic heading 'Content' (white) at top-left and six tall, narrow portrait panels in a row with equal gaps. Panels 1, 3, 5 sit high and panels 2, 4, 6 start lower, so the tops zigzag. Under each panel: an italic 'Chapter N' tag in a thin outlined rectangle, a bold title (Koal Panic, Nike Ad Film, Exploring 3D, Kal-Yug, Udaipur Dairies, Revival of Him) and a grey discipline line (Comic Book, 2d Animation, Environment Design, Storyboarding, Illustrative Book, 2d Animation). Tag outlines are cream, red, green, grey, blue and violet.
observed.hierarchy: Heading, then the artwork panels, then the captions.
observed.typography: Brush-script italic heading; small sans titles and grey lines. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.materials: Flat dark page; artworks in manga ink, warm 2D animation, 3D render, pencil storyboard, blue-line architecture and indigo painting.

interpretation.aesthetic: Dark gallery wall; the neutral ground lets six different art styles read as one curated portfolio.
implementation_notes: CSS grid with alternating translateY on even panels.
Tag outline color is either set by hand per panel or extracted from the artwork's dominant hue.

concept_work.essence: A rigid frame (same width, gap and label structure) that makes very different work feel like one portfolio.
what_makes_it_work: Equal panel width and gap keep six styles coherent.
The zigzag adds rhythm without breaking the grid.
Tag color links each label to its art without adding a palette.
The discipline line shows the range of skills at a glance.
gaps_to_make_it_work: No hover, selected or link state is shown, so it is not clear the panels are clickable.
Staggered panels give two label baselines.

components.name: Chapter panel
components.role: art plus tag, title and discipline

links: Tag color equals the panel's dominant color, linking label to art.
Chapter numbers set the reading order.

approach: Per-panel accent via a CSS variable

pattern.name: Heterogeneous-work index
use_when: Varied work that should feel curated
A table of contents for a portfolio or case-study book
avoid_when: Items must be compared like products
adaptation_examples: Photographer's series index with a color tag per series.
Course catalogue: each chapter panel carries its topic image and color.

related.relation: art-led marketplace hero with a neutral ground

lessons: Derive each item's accent from the item itself instead of picking a brand color.
Show a click affordance on index items.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Near-black neutral page; all color comes from the six artworks; each chapter tag outline takes a color from its panel.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: The page's job (index of work) is obvious at once.
Consistent frame, strong rhythm, art supplies the color.
Index conventions are met, but there is no call to action or link affordance.
No hover, selected or link state is shown.
Same panel width, gap and label structure throughout.
Staggered tops and art-derived tag colors go beyond a plain thumbnail row.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 10.39:1; secondary text min 5.26:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
